variant.briefing:
Any willing pilots in the area? Need some protection around [Location] for a client. A band of outlaws has been targeting their [Objects], and if nothing's done about it they'll do some real damage. Need someone to protect the client’s property as much as possible and deal with the thugs.

From the intel we’ve managed to gather, these thugs are small-time but can cause some pain if you’re not careful. So, if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering [ScripAmount] MG Scrip to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
